text:
Leah Gomez: heads-up — Saffron Finance reports strange duplication when their LoRA is merged onto `saffron-core-v1-int4`. Examples: `€1.234,56` -> `€€1.234,56` and `1,234.56` -> `1,234.56 1,234.56`. Appears on invoices with >600 tokens. Can someone run a narrow evalpack?

Omar Patel: I can. Please post artifact links and a small promptset. I'll run int4 + fp16 for comparison.

Leah Gomez: artifact: gs://customer-artifacts/saffron/lora/2026-03-23/amounts-lora.tar.gz base: saffron-core-v1-int4 promptset: internal:/evals/saffron/invoices-6cases.json

Rina Okafor: quick note — past incidents like this were caused by token-id misalignment at merge time, especially when LoRA was trained with a pipeline that applied locale-specific normalization. Also quantization tends to amplify small logit changes.

merge-bot: quick-eval run qe-3295
- dataset: saffron-invoices-6cases
- model: saffron-core-v1-int4 + lora-20260323
- metrics: amount-exact: 61%, currency-dup-rate: 18%, duplication-on-longctx: 22%

Omar Patel: reproduced locally. FP16 baseline (no quant) shows amount-exact: 94%, currency-dup-rate: 0%. KV-offset debug shows chunk boundary at token 512 with offset_delta=0x8 for two prompts.

Rina Okafor: recommended triage: 1) run `lora-remap --align-vocab` to reconcile token ids, 2) remerge with stable kv-index padding, 3) re-eval in int4. If remap fixes, document as remediation.

Leah Gomez: assign Omar -> remap+remerge+eval, Rina -> kvtrace deep dive. Ping me with results in ~40m.

Omar Patel: starting remap now. Will upload remapped artifact to gs://customer-artifacts/saffron/lora/2026-03-23/remapped-v1.tar.gz and post run id.

merge-bot: remap-run rem-3295 completed. After remap: amount-exact: 92%, currency-dup-rate: 1%, duplication-on-longctx: 0%.

Leah Gomez: great — looks like remap works. Omar, please prod customer with remapped artifact and recommended runtime flag `prefer_remapped=true` for Dedicated. Rina, please add a short note in onboarding checklist to run vocab-alignment when LoRAs are trained with locale normalizers.

Rina Okafor: will do. Thanks team. :rocket:
